about: After document emits replan_remaining on S1 because TF1 uncovered string query-param validation needed in S2, step-plan preserves S1 verbatim with done: true and amends S2 to parse and validate query parameters.

request.prompt: Fix paginate() in src/paginate.js so trailing partial pages work accurately and expose paginated /items in src/server.js. R-1: Return all items for trailing partial pages (Math.ceil total pages) and expose paginated /items in server.js.

work_item.title: Fix pagination and add paginated /items route
work_item.context: Fix src/paginate.js (S1) then add /items in src/server.js (S2).

result.summary: Two steps: S1 fixes paginate (C1); S2 exposes paginated /items (C2).

criteria.text: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 3, 2) returns {page: 3, pages: 3, items: [5]}. Confirm by: running node --test --test-reporter=spec test/paginate.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.
GET /items returns paginated response in server.js. Confirm by: running node --test test/server.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.

result.check_na: Dependency-free Node fixture has no separate lint or build step.

result.summary: Fixed src/paginate.js page calculation with Math.ceil.
learned: paginate throws RangeError for non-integer query arguments.
decisions: Keep strict Number.isInteger validation inside paginate.

result.summary: Verified TC-1 and boundary TC-1 (a); recorded TF1 noting S2 must parse and validate integer query params.

test_findings.finding: S2 server.js GET /items receives string query params and must parse and validate positive integer page/size bounds (returning 400 on invalid input) before calling paginate().
test_findings.evidence: test/paginate.test.js TC-1 (a) and RangeError guard in src/paginate.js
test_findings.next_step: Emit replan_remaining at document so S1 commits and step-plan amends S2.

result.summary: Documented S1 paginate() trailing partial-page behavior and emitted replan_remaining for S2.

knowledge.spec: Noted R-1 trailing partial-page pagination contract (W1/S1).
knowledge.architecture: Unchanged; S1 keeps strict Number.isInteger validation inside paginate().

replan_remaining.reason: TF1 showed S2 server.js GET /items must parse and validate string query parameters before calling paginate().

planted.what: Preserves committed step S1 verbatim as steps[0] with done: true and leaves S2+ pending.
Amends pending step S2 / C2 to incorporate TF1 query-parameter parsing and positive integer validation.

controls.what: Amends the plan cleanly without modifying src/paginate.js or src/server.js directly during step-plan.
